claim: What Metric Modulation Is § and The 3/4 Symmetry §: the listener hears a smooth transition 'because the underlying rhythmic grid doesn't stop; it reinterprets', and the drop and the snap-back are mirror images. Felt time vs clock time is the whole claim, and it is only audible.

pieces.what: a pulse with a dotted-quarter accent; at the pivot the accent becomes the beat (120 → 80); tap along and see whether your taps re-lock without a gap; tests the 'grid reinterprets' claim on the reader's own entrainment
pieces.walks_up_from: a steady 120 BPM pulse with one accent pattern

pieces.what: the round trip 120 → 90 → 120 rendered, with the shared anchor hit marked; tests whether the return 'hits with recognition'
anchored vs unanchored modulation A/B; tests that the anchor is what makes it smooth
pieces.walks_up_from: one kick on the dotted quarter
